capabilities: Navigate search results with hotkeys in a dedicated search mode
Preview selected results in a card view or a larger modal
Auto-preview results in single or card view layouts
Set search options via a hotkey
extras: Manual preview is not supported in the legacy editor; a troubleshooting section covers hotkeys failing after a search.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances the built-in search function by providing
problem: The built-in search panel is mouse-oriented and offers only small result previews, making it hard to scan and open matches from the keyboard.
summary: Keyboard-driven enhancement of Obsidian's built-in search that adds hotkey navigation, card view, and larger previews of results.
